reviews.x: I love these so much I bought a second box right after trying it. Such a great sheet mask. Diminishes puffiness and leaves my skin looking even and bright. It really is like an 'energy drink for your face'. I have around 10 different face masks in my collection, and this is definitely one of my top 3 favorites. I couldn't be more pleased with my purchase, and I intend to buy more when I run out.

Nothing has ever given me such incredible results as quickly and efficiently as this did. i got my masks on Friday, tried it on Sunday night, and woke up today (Monday) with clearer tone, dramatically reduced smile lines, and overall my skin feels and looks healthier.  I am beyond impressed and even though I only bought these because they were on sale and seemed worth the try, I will contInue to purchase and use as directed (2 times/week). I really like this mask! It plumped up my face making my fine lines almost invisible and my skin felt very soft and hydrated. I wish that the eye openings were a little wider,  the mask laid sort of over my eyes on the outer corners.  For my next one I use I will just cut it a little.  Problem solved! Overall I would recommend this product.

Sheet masks and I don't have the best relationship, but I wanted to try more honey products, so I gave the honey masks a go. I usually have a problem with sheet masks sliding over my eyes, but found these to stay comfortably in place.  20 minutes passed without me having to fix the mask at all, and my skin definitely felt softer and had a bit of a glow to it!  The only downside was that my skin felt a bit sticky, but not to the point that I had to wash my face afterward.  Love these, and would t
This does not fit my face at all. I'm Asian and the eye area was cut too thin for my eyes and doesn't fit my nose. This mask is like the size of a little kid's face.

I really like these masks. They don't irritate my sensitive skin lie some brands do. I use this at night before bed and I wake up and my skin is softer and looks better. It makes my face seem brighter and refreshed. Who can hate that. I will definitely repurchase these and I'm looking forward to getting more from this brand.

This pack is a great sheet mask bargain. I have skin which can be sensitive, and this product was incredibly gentle. I applied the mask as part of my pre-bed routine. The package has quite a bit of extra serum in the envelope which is massaged into my face, neck and hands after using the mask. My skin was noticeably softer and well-moisturized without been greasy this morning. Non-comedogenic. The only reason this isn’t a five star product is due to the somewhat sticky nature of the serum as it

For starters, I tried the collagen one which I got in an Ipsy order. For all the people writing that the mask fits wonky and is too small — you’re probably right, BUT I’m petite (5’ tall!) and this mask fit my face better than many many others. For once, my eye, lip, and nose are properly covered without gaping spots, and the edges of the mask go to my hair and jaw line instead of being IN my hair and dripping down my neck. These masks were my first experience with sheet masks. My skin is super dry so I was intrigued by the hydrating collagen. The mask was relatively easy to put on, even for an amateur. I did find that the eye holes were a little small and were forcing the mask to pull away from my nose so I ((carefully)) cut little slits to make the eye area fit better. My skin felt super moisturizer after 20 min and it didn't leave a gross residue. I definitely recommend these and will be trying more of their pro

reviews.t: ... is my second order of this product and I love this mask
reviews.x: This is my second order of this product and I love this mask. I’ve used other collagen mask and this one has the best results for me. It’s hydrating, my skin feels amazing the next day. I use it twice a week and the xtra serum I use on my arms, the back of my hands and décolleté and there still a lot of serum left. I read somewhere to maximize the serum afte using one side for 15 minutes you should flip the mask over and use that side for another 15 minutes. Hope this helps.

reviews.t: Love the Grace & Stella Collagen Masks
reviews.x: Love the collegen masks.  I bought a pack of six and noticed a huge improvement in my skin after using only 3.  Needless to say, I immediately bought another pack of six because I don't want to run out.  The masks make my skin so soft and smooth and the really do provide superior moisturizing.  I definitely recommend Grace & Stella Collagen Facial Masks.
My face just didn’t feel that different after using them. They were not very rich.
Nice, not outstanding.Little response noted. Face seemed softer for a short time.

Wow, this product didn't work for me at all!  The eye holes are tiny and really close together. There's a lot of product on there, which is a plus. When I rub the product down my neck (both times I used this) I ended up with an intense burning/itching reaction on my neck, so clearly I'm allergic to something on there. My face didn't have that reaction, but afterwards it did wind up all bumpy, especially around my chin.  I tried it twice, just to be sure I really didn't like it. Won't be using th

I loved the green tea masks! Felt so conditioning on my skin while i was wearing it and left my skin feeling so soft the next morning when i woke up. The formula was perfect and smelled really good also. I can't get over how soft my skin feels after I use it! Definitely buying the green tea mask again and may even try the other ones too.

I’m pretty finicky when it comes to sheet masks but really enjoyed these. I used the collagen ones. They are soaked in essence which I enjoy so I can use the extra on my neck and hands. The fit was nice and comfortable and most importantly stayed on without sliding around. My skin after felt plump and very soft. Definitely recommend!

Typically I do not buy stuff like this because I’m not confident it’s worth the price (which is usually very high for skin care) ; however, I cannot begin to express how impressed I am with the whole product line of Grace and Stella Co.  I have purchased at least four different products and am a returning customer for life!

These masks leave my combination skin so soft and healthy.  I've used other masks that left a thick coat of moisturizer that I had to wash off.  After using this mask for 30 minutes, I rubbed the remaining product into my face (and my hands) and my skin soaked it right up.  My skin feels tighter and smoother.  I love it!

reviews.t: Gorgeous glowing skin after one use
reviews.x: As a single mother of two who runs on very little sleep I have started to become concerned about fine lines and wrinkles. I purchased the collagen facial sheet masks in hopes that they'd get me on my way and I am so pleasantly surprised. After one use I woke up with dewy, glowing, fresh looking skin. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: I will continue to give this a try but compared ...
reviews.x: I will continue to give this a try but compared to other sheet masks I have used, these are a total pain to unfold and get them on your face. I about threw away the first one because it was a tangled mess. The eye holes are small but I don't mind that so much, I just wish it was easier to unfold and get on.

reviews.t: These masks are amazing, and will definitely smooth and plump your skin ...
reviews.x: These masks are amazing, and will definitely smooth and plump your skin like they claim. I find that they work really well after exfoliating in the shower, and will make your pores even smaller after a clay face mask. The sheet itself is also really fine which allows your skin to soak up even more product.

I don't typically use face masks, since they can cause my face to break out, but I thought I'd give it another go with the Grace & Stella cucumber mask, and I loved it!!! It was very light and smooth, easy to use, and made my skin feel super soft and cool afterwards! can't wait to try the other kinds!!

Absolutely in love with these!! I'm not one to leave reviews much, but this product left my face feeling phenomenal. it's 12 hours later and my skin still feels soft and hydrated (I have very dry skin). I will definitely purchase this product again, and will try out more from their line! :)

I have only used this mask once, but loved it! I have sensitive skin and some masks tingle too much for me, but not this one. After using the mask, my face felt so soft and smooth. It still did for a couple days. I will continue to use them and hopefully see more improvements in my skin.

reviews.t: I like that it comes in a multi pack
reviews.x: I'm usually not a fan of face masks because they don't stay on my face well. These ones really stayed put without being drippy and goopy. It felt a little tacky once I took it off but I'm the morning my skin felt moisturized and smooth. I like that it comes in a multi pack.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the masks leave their skin softer, brighter, and more hydrated, often noticing results by the next morning.
Several reviewers report the mask fits too small or the eye holes are too small and close together, though a petite reviewer found the fit good.
Some reviewers with sensitive skin found the masks gentle and non-irritating, while one reported a burning/itching reaction.
A few reviewers felt little to no difference in their skin after use.
Reviewers appreciate the extra serum in the package, using it on their neck, hands, and other areas.
